source_title: GIL INVESTOR ALERT: Gildan Activewear Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the GIL Securities Class Action
source_excerpt:
SAN FRANCISCO , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ï­ Hagens Berman, a prominent national trial law firm specializing in securities fraud and shareholder rights, alerts investors in Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL ) to a class action lawsuit filed in federal court.
The firm encourages Gildan investors who purchased shares on the NYSE only and suffered substantial losses to submit your losses now .
Class Period: Feb. 19, 2025 â June 15, 2026
The Gildan Activewear class action lawsuit alleges that throughout the Class Period, Defendants made false and/or misleading statements regarding the company's financial condition, internal controls, and sales growth drivers.
Specifically, the complaint alleges Defendants concealed that:
Gildan engaged in channel stuffing by overloading wholesalers and distributors with excess inventory to artificially inflate reported sales and organic growth metrics;
The company's top-line revenue growth was driven by unsustainable inventory pull-forwards rather than genuine market share gains;
Gildan's offering and M&A disclosures overstated projected synergies and growth prospects relating to its acquisition of HanesBrands while concealing peak Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and distributor saturation.
The Truth Emerges: On June 16, 2026, activist short-seller Jehoshaphat Research published a detailed investigative report titled "Stuffing All of the Channel Some of the Time?" detailing Gildan's alleged reliance on aggressive premature sales recognition and distributor channel saturation. Following this report, Gildan's stock price fell $11.62 per share, or 18.75% , closing at $50.35 on heavy trading volume.
If you suffered substantial losses purchasing or acquiring Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL ) stock during the Class Period (February 19, 2025 â June 15, 2026), you may seek appointment as Lead Plaintiff for the class before the December 14, 2026 deadline.
Direct Contact: Contact Reed Kathrein, Partner, leading the securities practice group, by calling (844) 916-0895 or emailing [email protected] .
"Our investigation is focused on whether Gildan may have engaged in improper sales and revenue recognition practices," said Reed Kathrein , the Hagens Berman partner leading the firm's investigation.
Whistleblowers: Persons with non-public information regarding Gildan should consider their options to help in the investigation or take advantage of the SEC Whistleblower program. Under the new program, whistleblowers who provide original information may receive rewards totaling up to 30 percent of any successful recovery made by the SEC. For more information, call Reed Kathrein at 844-916-0895 or email [email protected] .
